Similarly, if you write: ```javascript var image2 = document.querySelectorAll("img")[1]; ``` - It selects the **second** image (`.img2`). ### Alternative: Instead of using `[0]`, you could directly select the first image with: ```javascript var image = document.querySelector(".img1"); ``` This is **cleaner and more efficient** when targeting a single element.
